description: This file defines extension methods for IServiceCollection to add various services related to the Conduit application, including MediatR setup, validation, JWT authentication, and logging configuration.

classes.name: ServicesExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for IServiceCollection to configure services for the Conduit application.

methods.name: AddConduit
methods.description: Adds MediatR, validation, AutoMapper, and scoped services for Conduit to the IServiceCollection.

methods.name: AddJwt
methods.description: Configures JWT authentication options, token validation parameters, and adds JWT bearer authentication scheme.

methods.name: AddSerilogLogging
methods.description: Configures Serilog logging and attaches it to the ILoggerFactory.
